manifest.title: Baseball Pitching Analyzer
manifest.author: bstrana
manifest.description: Real-time baseball pitching and swing mechanics analysis, powered by TensorFlow.js pose detection running entirely in the browser. Track pitching/hitting mechanics live from a webcam, or upload and replay video, mark a range, and analyze just that portion for joint speed metrics and a kinematic sequence chart. Also includes a strike zone / pitch tracker overlay and telestrator-style drawing annotations. All video processing happens client-side - no video or pose data is uploaded to or stored on the server.
manifest.tagline: Real-time baseball pitching & swing mechanics analysis
